dub j.bio: Dub J is a Canadian producer and songwriter from Kitchener-Waterloo whose career spans more than two decades. He has worked with Canadian artists including Classified, JD Era, Maestro Fresh Wes, Jully Black, Choclair, Saukrates and Paris Richards, and became known for large-scale collaboration projects such as Love 2 Hate. Northern Dial carries Dub J as part of Canada's hip-hop production history.

earth to emily.bio: EARTH TO EMILY is a Toronto-born pop artist and songwriter whose music blends modern pop with R&B and dance influences. Raised in Toronto and later working between major North American music centres, she has built an independent catalogue that includes projects such as SOCIALITE RODEO and E2E. Northern Dial carries EARTH TO EMILY as part of Canada's contemporary pop scene.

fabjustfab.bio: FABjustfab is a Montreal-based rapper, beatboxer, musician and producer, and a co-founder of alternative hip-hop group Random Recipe. Her solo work blends hip-hop, funk, R&B and Latin influences, building on years of international touring and festival appearances. Northern Dial carries FABjustfab as part of Quebec's contemporary independent hip-hop scene.

freq motif.bio: Freq Motif is a Toronto electronic duo formed in 2020 by two Canadian producers. Their music mixes world, dance and Latin influences with pop-minded production, with releases including Hot, Sirena and Nice To Meet Ya. Northern Dial carries Freq Motif as part of Toronto's contemporary electronic scene.

gritfall.bio: Gritfall is a Toronto hip-hop artist associated with the city's current underground rap scene. The catalogue includes solo material and collaborations with artists including Shadee, Forest N/A and Rico Blox. Northern Dial carries Gritfall as part of its emerging Canadian hip-hop coverage.
